reviews.t: They love it. Has every color from light to dark
reviews.x: bought a set for each daughter. They love it. Has every color from light to dark, pastels to chromes. You will need to get a storage box for them.

I love the selection that I received. I got metallics, a few glitters, pastels, and fracture ones. I am not a fan of fracture ones, but they do work like they are supposed to so I can't rate it down one that. Most of the colors look great after just two applications. I do very thin layers so that they dry quicker. I use a top coat with all of my nail polishes. I know with it they have lasted me a week. I couldn't be happier with my purchase and have already recommended them for my sister.

claims.text: Many reviewers are pleased with the large color selection and variety in the 30-piece set.
Several reviewers report damaged, leaked, broken, or dried-up bottles upon arrival.
Some reviewers say the colors received did not match the photos or expected shades.
Reviewers praise the polish quality, coverage, and fast drying.
